title: gastrochilus scaphochlamys
intro: Gastrochilus scaphochlamys, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, bronchitis, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Gastrochilus scaphochlamys include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which make it effective in reducing pain and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and modulating the immune system.
